tools.name: tickets_get

params.name: id
params.description: Stable Toretabi ticket ID, for example tokai_043

tools.name: tickets_list
tools.description: Discover tickets in a bounded native area/type listing. Optional: area, ticket-type.

params.name: area
params.description: Native area code 1 to 11 from the source catalog

params.name: ticket-type
params.description: Native ticket type code: 1 early purchase, 2 multiple tickets, 3 return discount, 4 free area
